title: skills/objectui teaches ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' }), which sends discovery to /api/v1/api/v1/discovery, so connect() fails and every adapter call with it
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a wrong instruction in shipped text, with named locations. Found by the #27678 card thread (dev report 6510080703, `out_of_scope_findings`, carrier: seat) and verified from source by the contract review of PR #27764 (record 6510354851, ③). Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. Filed without `domain:*`: the skill text is `domain:skills`; the adapter's discovery line is `ui/**`. Triage sets the lane or splits.

Business reason: a customer agent that loads the `objectui` skill and wires a real backend is told to write `new ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' })`. The adapter treats `baseUrl` as an origin for discovery, so the app's first call fails and every read and write fails after it. The skill teaches a configuration that cannot work. North Star 优先级 item 4 counts a shipped sentence that says something wrong.
Reader who acts: the lane triage assigns. One os-dev, one PR (or two after a split).
Dedupe: issues searched for `ObjectStackAdapter baseUrl` and `api/v1/api/v1` → no card.

## Measured (`origin/main`, read from source, not run live)

1. `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` teaches `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` at `:133`, `:155`, `:218`, `:461` (line numbers at PR #27764's head `a5cbb8fc`; all four lines predate that PR).
2. `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3432-3435` builds discovery as `baseUrl + '/api/v1/discovery'` with no suffix strip. The adapter's own search, data, export and meta paths (`:3765-3769`, `:5162-5167`, `:5294-5298`, `:5463-5467`) DO strip a trailing `/api/vN`, so the adapter disagrees with itself.
3. `packages/client/src/index.ts:1704`, `:1733`: `ObjectStackClient` takes an origin and joins every route as `${this.baseUrl}${route}`, where routes are absolute `/api/v1/...` paths.
4. Every adapter read and write awaits `connect()` first (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3656`, `:3844`, `:4378`, …).
5. The console passes an origin: `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:105` (`VITE_SERVER_URL || ''`).

## Wanted

- Measure the failure once (a live `os dev` plus the adapter with `baseUrl: '/api/v1'`, or a unit pin on the discovery URL).
- Skill half: teach the origin form the console uses (`''` behind a same-origin proxy, or the server origin) at all four places, and add or adjust an eval so the wrong form is refused. Keep the skill's line budget neutral or negative.
- Adapter half (`ui/**`), for triage to place: either the discovery line strips a trailing `/api/vN` like the four sibling paths do, or the adapter refuses a `baseUrl` that ends in `/api/vN` loudly. Contract-tightening is preferred over silent tolerance; triage or the maintainer picks.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "baseUrl: '/api/v1'" -- skills` → 0 hits.
- The adapter either reaches discovery with the taught `baseUrl`, or refuses the wrong one with a named error, pinned by a test.
